beats.beat: Phoebe runs up and finds Augusta fainted beside an overturned trunk of letters, with Harker kneeling over her and every coldness gone out of him.

Revived, Augusta tells Phoebe that her engagement was broken that spring when her intended's family called her a fortune-hunter over the Marchmont bequest, so she came away where no one knew her face.

Harker admits he settled Phoebe's account himself, ashamed of having wronged her over the cancelled order, and kept his name off it, since any known kindness from the house would set the parish asking why it burned lamps at all.
Voices carry up from below: Mrs Pike and Mrs Hale have followed the lit windows to the open front door.

turn.note: Mrs Pike's voice arriving at the open door hands the next chapter its confrontation and its matchmaking turn.

generic_prose.quote: There was nothing left in his voice of the man who had stood in the hall on Thursday and told her that her business was the cloth.
generic_prose.replace_with: Show the change physically — a shaking hand, dropped formality — rather than stating the transformation abstractly.

generic_prose.quote: A voice came up the staircase out of the hall below, warm and perfectly sure of itself, and a second voice under it agreeing.
generic_prose.replace_with: Replace the adjectives with a specific detail of what was actually heard, or let the dialogue line that follows carry the identification alone.

trope_note: Delivers the secret benefactor reveal straight and advances the matchmaker's entrance; enemies-of-manner cools but is not yet resolved, which is correct for this point in the arc.
